findings.text: reckon/crew/landing_measure.py:940 `armed_observations` re-orchestrates the two-arm suite path already owned by `measure_run` (landing_measure.py:715): it repeats the config/partition resolution, `_carry_missing_tests`, the two `_arm` calls and the unreadable loop rather than factoring the shared suite-arm measurement out of the owner. It extends the owner by composing `armed_argv`/`_arm`/`_partition_runner` rather than replacing it, but a later fix to the arm-orchestration (timeout sizing, partition wiring, missing-test carry) must now be made in two places.

reckon/crew/promotion_records.py:1017 `_measure_missing_arms` overlaps the landing-side measurement already owned by `queue_landing._measure_delivery` (queue_landing.py:1040), which measures a delivered run's suite arms at a base and a head checkout. It is not a plain duplicate: it measures at the run's dispatch base against the run's own worktree head rather than current primary against a merge candidate, and it yields the manifest observation shape `_evaluate_suite_delta` consumes. The overlap is worth recording so a future change to how the landing measures a run's arms does not silently diverge between the two paths.

reckon/crew/promotion_records.py:1017 the node's done-when also requires 'ruff check and ruff format --check add no findings on staged paths', but the manifest records no ruff result. I verified both clean here (ruff check: All checks passed; ruff format --check: 3 files already formatted), so the omission is a recording gap in the manifest, not a defect in the change.

VERDICT goal: the run's goal is to have a landing measure a missing, mismatched or wrong-revision armed arm itself on a compute partition instead of refusing on it; reckon/crew/promotion_records.py:1017 `_measure_missing_arms` now takes that reading via landing_measure.armed_observations and lands the run on it.
VERDICT done_when: the done-when names tests/test_a_landing_measures_a_mismatched_arm.py covering a superseded-head after arm, a mismatched baseline command, a missing after arm, an unmeasured matching pair and an added-failure refusal, plus both suite arms at base and head; the manifest records all of these and the logs carry the arms (baseline 6 failed/49 passed/2 errors EXIT=1; after 57 passed EXIT=0).
VERDICT write_paths: the run declared promotion_records.py, landing_measure.py, queue_landing.py, the new test file and the evidence fragment; the diff touches exactly four of those and nothing outside them.
VERDICT manifest: read; it states status complete, names both arm logs, the negative control log, the arm commands and results, and its commit list 40a055fe78 and 82010770b8.
VERDICT diff: read commit by commit against dc998c198357ad7ea094138fcc4b75c4ba148232; 40a055fe78 adds arm_observation/armed_observations to landing_measure.py and _measured_arm_tree/_measure_missing_arms/_record_measured_arms plus the measured-arms branch in _evaluate_suite_delta, and 82010770b8 adds only the evidence fragment; 537 insertions, no deletions.

JUSTIFICATION goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/promotion_records.py:1157 calls _measure_missing_arms and adopts the measured pair when the recorded arms are missing, mismatched or at another revision, which is exactly what the goal asks.

SCORE scope_discipline: 19
JUSTIFICATION scope_discipline: the four changed paths in the diff are all inside the five declared fenced paths and queue_landing.py, though declared, was not modified.
SCORE durability: 17
JUSTIFICATION durability: tests/test_a_landing_measures_a_mismatched_arm.py:216-217 assert delta['measured_by'] == 'run' and measured['calls'] == 0, so a regression that measures an already-matching pair reddens them, and the negative-control test at line 238 reinstates the refusal and asserts 'after_suite.revision_matches_head' in missing_fields; the partition-wiring branch and _measured_arm_tree's None path are not exercised.
SCORE fit: 18
JUSTIFICATION fit: the new functions follow landing_measure.py's existing private-helper idiom and promotion_records.py's deferred-import style, and no added name carries a plan, stage, issue or version identifier.
SCORE reuse: 11
JUSTIFICATION reuse: reckon/crew/landing_measure.py:940 composes the owner's helpers (armed_argv, _arm, _partition_runner, _carry_missing_tests) but re-orchestrates measure_run's two-arm path at landing_measure.py:715, and promotion_records.py:1017 overlaps queue_landing._measure_delivery's landing-side arm measurement, so the capability is extended but partly forked.
FINDING reckon/crew/landing_measure.py:940 non-blocking: armed_observations repeats measure_run's suite-arm orchestration (partition setup, _carry_missing_tests, two _arm calls, unreadable loop) instead of factoring it out of the owner, so an arm-orchestration fix must be made twice.
FINDING reckon/crew/promotion_records.py:1017 non-blocking: _measure_missing_arms overlaps queue_landing._measure_delivery, which already measures a delivered run's arms at a base and a head checkout; it differs in base revision and output shape, so it neither wraps nor replaces the owner.
FINDING reckon/crew/promotion_records.py:1017 non-blocking: the manifest records no ruff result although the done-when requires ruff check and ruff format --check clean on staged paths; verified clean here, so it is a recording gap rather than a code defect.
